data.name: Tiny Taxi
data.detailed_description:
Survive the city!

Tiny taxi is a survivor game where you cruise around a 2D top down pixel art city. Look for passengers on the streets and complete rides to earn money for upgrades. The game features a day and night cycle and each night the city gives you a curse to make each run different and more challenging. Earn a score for each run and compete on the leaderboard. Will you become the greatest cab driver there ever was?

Features

  • Arcade driving with drifting, burnout, and satisfying physics

  • Unique passengers with their own quirks and satisfaction meters

  • A living city with a continuous day/night cycle

  • In-car radio to set the mood as you drive with original soundtrack

  • Score system that rewards skillful drifting and speed

  • Survivor mechanics where you need to balance upgrades of taxi and curses that make the run harder as timer progress

data.short_description: Behind the wheel of a trusty old cab you try to survive the cursed city long enough to escape. Cruise the streets, look for passengers to drive and earn money to upgrade your taxi. You will need it, watch out for the negative curses each night. The city doesn't want you to win.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x86_64 with SSE4.2 (e.g. Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support (e.g. Intel HD Graphics 510 / Skylake, AMD Radeon R5 / Kaveri)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x86_64 with SSE4.2, 4+ physical cores (e.g. Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with full Vulkan 1.2 support (e.g. NVIDIA GTX 1050, AMD RX 460)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
